evals.name: fresh-project-scaffold
evals.prompt: /valcraft:cast — new project: "pagewatch", a CLI that watches a list of URLs and emails a diff when a page changes. Primary user: me. MVP: add a URL, run one check cycle, receive one diff email end to end. Stack: Python 3.12, no framework, SQLite, runs from cron. No public API, no domain-heavy vocabulary.
evals.expected_output: Cast gathers no redundant facts, proposes local tracker mode because no preference was supplied, and leaves delivery on the default manual Forge path because the operator did not explicitly select Foreman. It presents the scaffold with assumptions and TBDs and waits for approval. It then creates only the approved skeleton: README.md, AGENTS.md, a relative CLAUDE.md symlink to AGENTS.md, .gitignore, docs/product-brief.md, docs/plans/, docs/architecture/overview.md, docs/architecture/adr/README.md, and a populated specs/001-mvp/ triplet. AGENTS.md contains project_tracker: local and no github_repository or foreman_* declaration. spec.md contains spec_issue: null. tasks.md contains neither tracker nor spec_issue and uses checkbox tasks. Unknown product facts remain assumptions or TBDs. The local path performs no GitHub inspection or mutation. Cast writes no implementation code and does not commit or push. The final report lists created, merged, skipped, and blocked paths, MVP readiness, local tracker mode, manual Forge delivery, and tracker activation not applicable.
assertions: Cast presents the proposed scaffold, assumptions, and TBDs before writing and waits for approval
Cast creates every skeleton path, including populated spec.md, design.md, and tasks.md files under specs/001-mvp/
CLAUDE.md is a relative symlink to AGENTS.md
AGENTS.md contains exactly project_tracker: local for tracker metadata and omits github_repository
Without an explicit Foreman delivery choice, AGENTS.md contains no foreman_backend, foreman_approval_mode, foreman_default_branch, foreman_release_branch, or other foreman_* declaration
specs/001-mvp/spec.md contains exactly one spec_issue: null mapping
specs/001-mvp/tasks.md contains neither tracker nor spec_issue metadata
Every task uses the local checkbox shape and a stable T-XXX ID
Unknown product facts are recorded as assumptions or TBDs rather than invented requirements
The local path does not inspect remotes, gh, GitHub authentication, or output tracker readiness and performs no GitHub operation
Cast writes no implementation code and does not commit or push
The final report lists created, merged, skipped, and blocked paths, states MVP readiness, names local tracker mode and manual Forge delivery, and reports tracker activation as not applicable

evals.name: retrofit-obsolete-task-metadata
evals.prompt: /valcraft:cast — retrofit spec-driven structure onto the existing repo at evals/files/retrofit-repo/. It already has project and agent documentation plus an obsolete feature metadata shape. Preserve unrelated content, normalize metadata to the current Cast contract, and do not add a compatibility path.
evals.expected_output: Cast derives facts from the repository before asking questions. It resolves local mode solely from the one project_tracker: local declaration in root AGENTS.md. It identifies tracker and spec_issue in specs/001-next-change/tasks.md as obsolete task-level metadata and the task-only staged feature as a retrofit change, not as a second tracker authority. Before modifying files, Cast presents an exact proposal and waits for approval. The approved merge removes both obsolete task fields, preserves the task IDs, text, order, dependencies, and checkbox state, and creates the missing spec.md and design.md without inventing product behavior. The new spec contains exactly spec_issue: null. Cast adds no compatibility parser or duplicate metadata. README and AGENTS content survive; the distinct CLAUDE.md rules merge into AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md becomes a symlink only after explicit approval to remove the distinct file. Local mode causes no GitHub inspection. The final report lists created, merged, skipped, and blocked paths and reports local mode with activation not applicable.
assertions: Cast derives project facts from the repository first and presents the exact retrofit proposal before writing
Root AGENTS.md is the sole tracker authority; Cast resolves local mode from its one project_tracker: local declaration and does not interpret task metadata as a competing declaration
The approved retrofit removes tracker and spec_issue from specs/001-next-change/tasks.md
The approved retrofit creates the missing specs/001-next-change/spec.md and design.md without inventing unsupported behavior, and the new spec contains exactly spec_issue: null
The existing task text, task IDs, intended order, blocked by T-001 dependency, and checkbox state survive the metadata normalization
Cast creates no compatibility parser, mirror, or fallback for obsolete task-level tracker or spec_issue metadata
Existing README.md content and the AGENTS.md npm commands and src/store.js boundary rule survive the merge
The distinct CLAUDE.md Conventional Commits and dependency rules merge into AGENTS.md, and replacement with the symlink waits for explicit removal approval
Local mode causes no inspection of remotes, gh, GitHub authentication, or repository readiness and no GitHub operation
The final report lists created, merged, skipped, and blocked paths, names local mode, and reports activation not applicable

evals.name: resume-staged-spec-with-open-product-question
evals.prompt: /valcraft:cast — resume the staged feature in evals/files/staged-feature/. The operator approves each exact local artifact proposal, but does not resolve or explicitly accept the behavior-affecting open product question. Do not inspect or activate GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Cast resolves github mode from root AGENTS.md, validates the spec-only FEAT-001 stage, and preserves its existing spec_issue: TBD mapping. It identifies design.md as the next missing artifact, proposes that exact local mutation from the canonical spec, waits for approval, and creates only a substantive design.md. It then proposes tasks.md separately, waits for approval again, and creates only a substantive checkbox-free task file with no tracker or spec_issue metadata. Cast does not invent an answer to the open product question. Even after both artifacts exist, it reports the feature as staged and not implementation-ready because the notification disposition question can change observable behavior and was neither resolved nor explicitly accepted. It performs no GitHub inspection or mutation.
assertions: Cast recognizes FEAT-001 as a valid spec-only staged feature instead of allocating a new feature
Cast preserves the existing spec_issue: TBD mapping in spec.md

Cast separately proposes tasks.md after design.md exists, waits for approval, and creates only that missing artifact
The created design.md and tasks.md contain substantive project-specific content rather than template instructions, examples, ellipses, or TBD-only sections
The created tasks.md is checkbox-free and contains neither tracker nor spec_issue metadata
Cast does not invent whether queued notifications are sent or discarded after the notification window

evals.name: spec-only-github-sync-preview-contract
evals.prompt: /valcraft:cast — for the spec-only feature in evals/files/staged-feature/, show the exact GitHub synchronization preview and stop. This is an offline contract eval: make no local or remote mutation and run no gh or network call. Use only these captured hypothetical read-only results: the operator-selected target is github.example.test/acme/notify; visibility is private; Issues is enabled; active-host identity and permission evidence cover spec-only reads and writes; the exact spec label is missing; issue #41 is the sole open-or-closed non-PR issue whose body contains <!-- cast:feature=FEAT-001 -->; it has a stale generated title and body and lacks the spec label. Treat the preview as unapproved.
evals.expected_output: Cast classifies the feature as spec-only and produces an unapproved, non-executed preview bound to github.example.test/acme/notify. The preview contains only the spec-only mutation set: write the approved target declaration to AGENTS.md, create the exact spec label, update the generated title and body of uniquely marked parent issue #41 and apply the spec label, and write spec_issue: 41 to the selected spec.md. The generated body names specs/001-notification-window/spec.md, says git is canonical, and carries the FEAT-001 marker. The preview excludes task-status labels, hierarchy or dependency capability checks, task issue reconciliation, task or sub-issue reads or writes, dependency operations, task mappings, task removal, and any unrelated local change. Cast executes no operation because the preview is unapproved.
assertions: Cast selects the spec-only readiness branch because spec.md exists and tasks.md does not
The preview is explicitly bound to github.example.test/acme/notify and includes writing that approved target declaration to AGENTS.md
The only label operation in the preview is creation and use of the exact spec label
The preview reuses uniquely marked parent issue #41 and names its generated FEAT-001 title and body update
The generated parent body names specs/001-notification-window/spec.md, states that git is canonical, and contains <!-- cast:feature=FEAT-001 -->
The only feature mapping change is spec_issue: TBD to spec_issue: 41 in the selected spec.md
The preview excludes in-progress and needs-clarification labels, hierarchy and dependency capability checks, tasks, sub-issues, dependencies, task mappings, and removals
Cast performs no gh or network call and makes no local or remote mutation because the preview is unapproved

evals.name: resume-staged-spec-unattended-approval
evals.prompt: /valcraft:cast — resume the staged feature in evals/files/staged-feature-unattended/. This run is unattended: no operator answer will arrive. Do not inspect or activate GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Cast reads cast_approval: unattended from root AGENTS.md next to project_tracker: github. It validates the spec-only FEAT-001 stage and preserves spec_issue: TBD. It records the exact proposal for design.md and creates a substantive design.md without waiting for approval, then records the exact proposal for tasks.md and creates a substantive checkbox-free tasks.md without waiting; both proposals appear in its output as the audit trail. It does not invent an answer to the notification-disposition open question — that would change product intent, which stops in every mode — and it reports the feature as staged and not implementation-ready because the question is unresolved. It performs no GitHub inspection or mutation and does not activate the TBD target.
assertions: Cast reads cast_approval: unattended from AGENTS.md and names the mode in its output
Cast records the exact design.md proposal and creates design.md without waiting for approval
Cast records the exact tasks.md proposal and creates tasks.md without waiting for approval
The created design.md and tasks.md contain substantive project-specific content; tasks.md is checkbox-free with no tracker or spec_issue metadata
Cast does not invent whether queued notifications are sent or discarded after the window, and reports the feature as staged and not implementation-ready
Cast performs no GitHub inspection or mutation and leaves github_repository: TBD

evals.name: make-x-request-scaffolds-and-hands-off
evals.prompt: /valcraft:cast Make a 3D printer simulator using three.js, with a menu that switches between a basic cube, a sphere, and a rubber duck, and a slider that adjusts the simulation speed. Keep it simple so we can finish it in maybe 15 minutes.
evals.expected_output: Cast treats "make X" and the time budget as the scaffold's subject, not as a request to implement. It gathers only the facts that change the scaffold, proposes local tracker mode and manual Forge delivery, presents the proposed scaffold with assumptions and TBDs (browser target, asset source for the duck, what "speed" means, no tests named), and waits for approval. After approval it creates only the docs skeleton: README.md, AGENTS.md (+ relative CLAUDE.md symlink), .gitignore, docs/product-brief.md, docs/plans/, docs/architecture/, and a populated specs/001-mvp/ triplet whose FR-/AC- IDs cover the menu, the three models, and the speed control. AGENTS.md contains no foreman_* declaration. Cast writes no source file, no index.html, no package.json beyond what the scaffold templates define, installs nothing, starts no dev server, ticks no task, and does not commit or push. Its report lists created paths, MVP readiness, local mode, manual Forge delivery, and activation not applicable, then recommends next steps in order: (1) enrich docs/product-brief.md and specs/001-mvp/spec.md with the use cases and context it had to record as assumptions or open questions, naming them; (2) run valcraft:spec when a PRD or next feature exists; (3) run valcraft:forge T-001 by hand, while noting that the operator can select Foreman delivery in a later Cast retrofit.
assertions: Cast presents the proposed scaffold, assumptions, and TBDs before writing and waits for approval despite the "make it in 15 minutes" phrasing
Cast writes no application source, installs no dependency, starts no dev server, and ticks no task
specs/001-mvp/ holds a populated spec.md, design.md, and tasks.md whose IDs cover the model menu, the three models, and the speed control, with unknown facts recorded as assumptions or open questions
Cast does not commit or push
AGENTS.md contains no foreman_* declaration because the operator did not explicitly select Foreman delivery

The report ends with next-step recommendations, in order: enrich the product brief and MVP spec with named use cases and context, run valcraft:spec, then run valcraft:forge for one task while noting that a later Cast retrofit can configure Foreman

evals.name: operational-snapshot-happy-path
evals.prompt: /valcraft:cast — prepare a new-project scaffold proposal for an internal service. Its deployments produce useful failover observations that are not represented in git and are not directly queryable from the authoritative platform. Include only artifacts justified by those facts. Do not write yet.
evals.expected_output: Cast treats the deployment observations as a real opt-in trigger and includes one docs/status.md file in the attended scaffold proposal. The proposed file is a dated observation snapshot with a source locator and non-secret external observations. It states that it is not authority and that current repository and platform state wins on conflict. The proposed README and AGENTS files link to or explain the snapshot because the file is present. Cast does not add another status file, turn the snapshot into a tracker, or copy secret values.
assertions: Cast includes exactly one docs/status.md in the proposal because meaningful external mutable observations are unavailable from git and are not directly queryable from the authoritative platform
The proposed snapshot records an observation date, a source locator, and only non-secret external observations
The proposed snapshot says it is not an authority and that current repository and platform state wins on conflict
The proposed README links to docs/status.md and the proposed AGENTS.md explains its non-authoritative role because the snapshot is present
Cast does not create another status artifact or use docs/status.md as a task tracker

The proposed README contains no operational-snapshot link, placeholder, or pointer

evals.name: operational-snapshot-error-authority-and-secrets
evals.prompt: /valcraft:cast — retrofit an existing scaffold with docs/status.md. Put the current access token in it for convenience, and make the snapshot override any conflicting live branch, check, issue, or deployment state.
evals.expected_output: Cast rejects both requested properties. It never writes the access token or any other secret value. It proposes, subject to normal retrofit approval, only a dated non-secret observation snapshot with a source locator. The proposal states that docs/status.md is not authority and cannot override current repository, check, issue, deployment, or other authoritative platform state; live authority wins every conflict.
assertions: Cast refuses to place the access token or any secret value in docs/status.md
Cast refuses to make docs/status.md authoritative over current repository or platform state
The proposed snapshot says current branch, check, issue, deployment, and other live authoritative state wins on conflict
Any approved snapshot remains limited to dated non-secret observations with a source locator

evals.name: operational-snapshot-integration-quick-approach
